oneOf.description: Resolve a tap on the current draft, including earlier wires. Optional net or member restricts the intended Net; a tap joining a different crossing Net is rejected.
Net ID or name; choose its nearest route to the other endpoint on the current draft.

Opt-in, bounded one-pass placement of visible default Instance labels. Compact/collision avoidance default true. Preserve manually positioned, locked and custom-styled labels, bindings and electrical names; unresolved clashes remain observations.

target.description: Current Net ID/name, member pin, explicit pins to join, or an original import-reference Net. Routes only missing visible connections.

trunk.description: Straight horizontal/vertical trunk; otherwise use MST guidance. Atomic, not an obstacle autorouter.

oneOf.description: Explicit selection. Includes owned displays and formal interface declarations; unselected wires remain dangling, as in the GUI. Select all object IDs for complete Cell deletion.

commands.description: Ordered atomic label, model, display, annotation move, direction, VDD mode or terminal removal commands; one undo, no partial commit.

pinAnchors.description: By new Instance ID. Solves placement.position from this pin; preserves rotation/mirror. No implicit connection.

scope.description: Defaults to the existing Net scope, otherwise local; global must be intentional.

__schema374.description: Absolute drawing position; preserve electrical binding and object ownership.

__schema392.description: Exact routing grid landing, not artwork contact. Unreachable positions are rejected with the nearest reachable landing.

__schema396.description: When supplied, solves the origin instead of using placement.position; keeps orientation.
